post.description: Creates a WAN synthesis: one run over the inputs the body carries. The record is written under the next id, never reused, with status creating, each element of a list input under it numbered in body order, and the synthesizer is started on it; the record then moves through synthesizing to success, fail or timeout, and the WAN's parts appear under the run once it ended success. Nothing under a run is written after creation; a changed input is a new run.
